name: Donkey kick
movement: one bent leg lifted until the thigh is in line with the back

phone.placement: Lay the phone on its side on the floor, two or three metres away, side on to where you will be.

words.hint: Phone on its side on the floor, side on to you, on your hands and knees, whole body in frame.
words.start: Lay the phone on its side on the floor, then get on your hands and knees side on to it, and kick one leg up.
words.position: On your hands and knees, side on to the phone, hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips, back level.
words.top: The working thigh in line with the back, knee still bent at a right angle, back level.
howto: Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, back level, neck long.
Keeping the knee bent at a right angle, lift the leg nearest the camera until the thigh is in line with the back.
Hold at the top for the count without arching the lower back to make height.
Lower slowly to the floor — the rep counts there. Sets alternate legs.
words.cannot: The hips rolling open toward the working side, and the far leg: it judges the arms, the back line and the lifted leg from the side. Keep the hips square yourself.
words.about: Donkey kick — on hands and knees, side on: the arms plumb from the floor, 85–105°, elbows straight (at least 165°); the back level, hip to shoulder within ±10° of the floor; the working knee at a right angle, 80–100°; and the lift, the angle at the hip between knee and shoulder, at least 160° at the top and no more than 5° above the line. Hold two seconds at the top, lower slowly, and the rep counts when the knee is back down. One leg per set, the sets alternating.
words.lost: Get onto your hands and knees, side on to the camera
words.early: Hold it at the top next time
words.safety: Height comes from the hip, never from arching the lower back. Stop if the back or the wrists hurt.
words.easier: A smaller lift; a shorter hold; forearms down instead of hands.
words.harder: A band around the thighs; an ankle weight; a longer hold at the top.
words.mistakes: Arching the back to lift higher; the knee straightening; the shoulders drifting behind the wrists.

measurements.label: knee angle
measurements.why: The working knee stays at a right angle.

measurements.label: knee, hip, shoulder

settings.label: Lift at the top, at least

measurements.why: The lift: about 90 kneeling, 180 with the thigh in line with the back. Also the progress measurement.

measurements.label: thigh above the back

settings.label: Thigh above the back, at most

measurements.why: The thigh's rise over the back's line: the knee above the hip plus the shoulder above the hip is zero when the three are in a line, positive when the knee is past it — the lower back arching to make height.

measurements.label: arm from the floor
measurements.why: The wrist-to-shoulder line from the floor: 90 plumb, over 90 the shoulders are ahead of the wrists (toward the head), under it behind them.

measurements.label: back off level
measurements.why: The hip-to-shoulder line off level: positive the shoulders above the hips (sagging), negative rounding.

faults.label: Shoulders behind wrists
faults.deep: Shoulders forward — you are sitting back on your heels

faults.label: Shoulders ahead of wrists
faults.deep: Shoulders back — they are well ahead of your wrists

faults.label: Elbows bent
faults.deep: Straighten your arms — the elbows are well bent

faults.label: Back sagging
faults.text: Lift your belly — your back is sagging
faults.deep: Belly up — your back is sagging toward the floor

faults.label: Back rounding
faults.deep: Flatten your back — it is rounding up

faults.label: Knee straightening
faults.text: Keep the knee bent — sole to the ceiling
faults.deep: Bend the knee to a right angle — the leg is straightening

faults.label: Knee too closed
faults.deep: Open the knee out to a right angle

faults.label: Thigh above back
faults.text: Not so high — thigh in line with your back
faults.deep: Lower it — the thigh is past your back and the back is arching

faults.label: Thigh short of the line
faults.text: Lift higher — thigh level with your back
faults.deep: Higher — knee, hip and shoulder in one line
